thermal_rule.without_temperature: continue after bounded 120-second wait only under exploratory scope; record failed stabilization and observed temperature; stop if system thermal pressure is non-nominal

randomization: 4 model blocks randomized with Python random.Random(20261113); six configurations randomized within each block; one model warm-up before its first measured request; no replicate SD.
power_policy: AC power, charging state recorded; component-energy estimates do not include battery charging

idle_rule.operator_condition: no inference, build, artifact render, or intentional foreground workload; normal desktop services recorded

scope_note: User-authorized single-pass Mac exploratory presentation pilot: 24 configurations (4 model/quant files x 3 input lengths x 2 output lengths), one measured request per configuration, one same-process warm-up per loaded model block. Results are not repeated controlled estimates and are not final two-device conclusions.
